description: Presidential Secretariat - Appointed Mr. W. M. V. Narampanawa as the Secretary to the Ministry of National Co-existence Dialogue & Official Languages and Mr. Bopage Nimalaweera as the Secretary to the Ministry of Parliamentary Reforms & Mass Media
categorisation: This gazette contains only government personnel changes (appointments of named individuals - Mr. W. M. V. Narampanawa and Mr. Bopage Nimalaweera) with basic titles (Secretary to specific ministries). It does not include detailed descriptions of portfolio responsibilities or subject matter areas, which would make it a Hybrid (Type 3). The content focuses exclusively on who is being appointed rather than what they will be responsible for.
